purpose: Continue lower-net-loss/cadre-return recovery into April while respecting the authoritative 30-Apr 280-300 ready four-carrier ceiling and charging training losses.

four_core.qualitative: A-/A- for one-cycle four-deck coordination; repeated long-range strike endurance and reserve attack-leader depth still below Branch 1942-43 mature peak.

training_cost_01_15Apr.note: Already netted into dated ready bands.

soft_progress_effect.cadre_effect: Veteran leaders/navigation cells shorten the tail of squadron conversion and reduce the share of all-new formations; does not create extra factory airframes.

guard: Do not extrapolate above deck/airframe capacity. Recovery now expresses itself increasingly in replacement depth, reserve crews and repeat-sortie resilience rather than raw embarked count.
